annotation.bound_parties_text: The notice is addressed to provincial, autonomous region and municipal governments and State Council ministries and agencies, who are asked to implement the plan; the plan also calls on relevant departments, regions, and enterprises to act.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: 各省、自治区、直辖市人民政府，国务院各部委、各直属机构：《新能源汽车产业发展规划（2021—2035年）》已经国务院同意，现印发给你们，请认真贯彻执行。
annotation.robot_provision_quote: 高度自动驾驶汽车实现限定区域和特定场景商业化应用
